description: A failed ARQ D_PDU too long for the configured transmission length goes in the next transmission even when an owed acknowledgement is placed before it: the limit may not block it, so the transmission is made the whole blocks the acknowledgement and the retransmission need.
note: As dts-tx-ed3-first-segment-stretches up to 86850: the 50-byte C_PDU went as one 68-byte ED3-DATA-ONLY, FSN 0, stretching the transmission to 2 blocks (interp C-1042), and dts.ack_wait/0.0.1.3 runs. At 91000 the peer's ED3-DATA-ACK arrives (type 2 on the 8-bit link, C-0190, C-0730; EOT 2; header length 4 + 4 + 2 = 10 after the 3-byte address): its own FSN 0, a 10-byte segment with C_PDU START only, DELIVER IN ORDER, TX WIN UWE and LWE, and RX LWE 0 with no selective acknowledgement bits. RX LWE 0 says our FSN 0 has not been received (C-0776), so it fails (C-0908; interp C-1121) and, with nothing left awaiting, dts.ack_wait stops (C-1120). The peer's segment is held (its C_PDU is incomplete, so nothing is delivered and the first-data wait runs on) and we owe it an acknowledgement, RX LWE 1. The transmission heard was addressed to us and ended with its EOM, so the LBT wait is zero (interp K-0120, two-node rule) and the contention wait is the third jitter draw of seed 0, 15 slots of 3000 ms = 45000 ms (prng.md: 15, 4, 15). At 137000 the build places the owed acknowledgement first and the retransmission of FSN 0 next (C-0852): a 12-byte ED3-ACK-ONLY and the 68-byte ED3-DATA-ONLY, 80 bytes, more than the one block (64 bytes) dts.max_transmission_ms 5550 allows. The retransmission keeps its size (C-0549) and the limit may not block it (C-0551, C-0878), so the transmission is made the whole blocks the acknowledgement and the retransmission need, 2 (interp C-1042, revised corpus 0.40.0 for issue #109: before, only the first D_PDU could stretch it, so the retransmission was skipped as a misfit after the acknowledgement every time one was owed). The single acknowledgement merges into the retransmission as an ED3-DATA-ACK (interp C-1152): header 4 + 4 + 2 = 10, flags C_PDU START and END, DELIVER IN ORDER, TX WIN UWE and LWE, segment size 50, FSN 0, RX LWE 1, then the unchanged segment and its CRC-32, 15 + 50 + 4 = 69 bytes, EOT ceil(9750 / 500) = 20 (C-0104, C-1043). The 59 spare bytes of the second block are filled with copies of the acknowledgement as ED3-ACK-ONLY D_PDUs (type 1, RX LWE 1, header length 4 + 1 + 2 = 7, 12 bytes each), four of them, the fifth not fitting; each starts in the second block, so its EOT is ceil(4950 / 500) = 10 (interp C-1154, C-1043); no PADDING towards an Ed3 peer (C-0367), and the last 11 bytes are zero filled by the modem. dts.ack_wait/0.0.1.3 starts when it ends at 147350. Header CRCs per C-0147 and segment CRCs per C-0157, computed with an independent encoder.
